title: Fixed Guyed Twin Gymnastic Ring Frame
description: One newly authored complete static gymnastic twin-ring frame. Two high upright columns carry a full transverse portal beam above two independent long flat hanging straps. Each strap terminates in a complete round-section wooden-looking ring with a genuine open centre. Four continuous outward stays connect the upper columns to four separate finite grounded anchor shoes; two broad main column shoes complete the six-point footprint. Every whole numeric component is newly authored. This is not the old one-column cantilever heavy-bag stand with rings substituted for the bag, the A-frame swing with its seat removed, or a raised version of rigid parallel bars: the full high portal, four outward stay routes and independent hanging grips form a different complete apparatus. Three constant opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, native Z up, full horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. One complete prop, zero scenes. Unoccupied fixed display only: no swinging or gymnastics motion, adjustable height, strap or cable tension, anchoring installation, athlete fit, official dimensions, stability, loading, manufacture or sports-equipment safety claim.
